messages:
maya: hitting a publish failure on regendiff step. typegen output reordered enums and bumped js-sdk from 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0; publish blocked because no changelog entry. also sample-app e2e started failing after pulling the artifact.

oliver: saw it. CI job //devex/publish:js-sdk-publish failed with:
```
ci-bot: regendiff found semantic changes in generated client. package.json version incremented.
ERROR: no changelog entry for new version. publish aborted.
```

ria: do we have a diff? could be nondeterministic generator ordering again.

maya: diff shows only enum ordering changed (no schema change):
```
- "modes": ["fast","safe","balanced"]
+ "modes": ["safe","fast","balanced"]
```
Semver-bot treats that as API surface change and bumped minor.

toni: sample-app break was auth retries looping — our retry logic assumed header array order and misread a 401 as transient. fixed locally by making header handling order-agnostic. opening PR.

sam: two fixes: (1) run typegen with deterministic sorting flag and add a regen golden test, (2) harden sample-app auth/retry. maya, can you open the typegen PR?

maya: yep. PR will set --stable-sort, add a golden diff test, and revert package.json to 1.2.0 to unblock publish. also add CHANGELOG note that this was a regen-only normalization.

oliver: short-term we can allow a one-off CI override to skip semver check with an audit comment. sam, want to handle that?

sam: I can add a temporary CI exception requiring two approvals and auto-expire in 72h. will reference the PR.

ria: long-term we should update semver analyzer to ignore pure-order-only diffs or run a normalization pass before semantic detection. filing DX-regen-21.

toni: sample-app PR opened: guard retry, case-insensitive headers, unit tests added. cc @sam for review.

maya: pushing typegen PR now; includes pregen check to ensure binary supports --stable-sort. cross-platform regen tests added.

ci-bot: action: rerun //devex/publish:js-sdk-publish after PR merges. use `runtool retry 3520009999`.

sam: thanks all. once both PRs are merged i'll kick off the rerun and then remove the CI exception. keep thread updated with any regendiff output.
